subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention qualification — next steps and ops milestones
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khalid <samira@finlay.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@finlay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention qualification — next steps and ops milestones

Hi Samira / Tom — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Key pain points you flagged
- Audit log access: need raw event-level logs (auth, API, admin) with integrity proofs for legal retention.
- Retention: regulatory requirement to retain logs and customer records for up to 6 years (Finlay internal policy).
- DPA & data residency: DPA redlines and clause on subprocessor list + encryption at rest proof.
- Pen test: procurement requires a coordinated pen test window and scope definition before production onboarding.

Goals you described
1) Get SOC 2 Type II evidence and sample audit logs for procurement review (week of Dec 13).
2) Agree DPA baseline and surface redlines for in-house legal to review (Dec 10).
3) Confirm pen test window in Jan and provide scope + checklist (target Jan 10–14).

Proposed next steps (owners & ETA)
- Jonas (me): deliver evidence matrix + sample logs by EOD Monday, 12/7 — attachment: initial-evidence-matrix.csv.
- Irene (Security): confirm which artifacts we can provide as redacted samples and timeline (EOD 12/8).
- Neha (Solutions Eng): prepare a short runbook for audit-log access/export and retention config (12/10).
- Finlay procurement: confirm preferred pen test window and any external vendor constraints.

Questions for you
1) Can procurement confirm the preferred pen test dates and whether they require a vendor NDA?
2) Any strict format for sample logs (CSV vs. JSON) preferred by your audit team?

Attachments: initial-evidence-matrix.csv (stub) — this is a first-pass mapping of typical SOC2 artifacts to what we can provide.

If that aligns, I’ll kick off the internal artifacts sync and share the SOC2 snapshot + sample logs early next week.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention qualification — next steps and ops milestones

Jonas — looping in Neha for the runbook. Quick internal alignment following Samira / Tom's asks:

What we can provide and estimated lead times
- SOC2 snapshot (summary of last Type II scope + attestation date): 48 hours.
- Sample audit logs (redacted): can provide a 7-day CSV extract with field mapping within 72 hours.
- Retention configuration doc (how to set retention windows & export): 3 business days.
- Encryption & key management evidence: short write-up + KMS ARNs — 48 hours.
- DPA draft: legal will prepare our standard DPA and flag the subprocessor appendix for redlines — 3 business days.

Pen test scope: engineering prefers a narrow surface for an initial vendor test (ingress, API auth, session handling). We should avoid full model-level whitebox unless procurement requires it — that increases scheduling lead time.

I attached an artifact-availability-chart.md with itemized owners and the earliest delivery date. I’ll start pulling the sample logs and coordinate redaction with Neha.

Irene Choi
Head of Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

From: Samira Khalid <samira@finlay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@finlay.com>
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention qualification — next steps and ops milestones

Thanks Jonas — that recap is very helpful. A few clarifications from our side so we can route to procurement/legal: 

- Retention: Finlay policy requires 6 years for audit logs and customer transaction metadata — confirm you can support a retention export on demand for the full 6-year window.
- Sample logs: CSV is preferred; include timestamp, actor_id, event_type, resource_id, request_id, and signature/checksum if available.
- Encryption: we need confirmation of encryption at rest (AES-256 or equivalent) and whether keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed.
- DPA: please share your DPA draft right away so our Counsel can start redlining.
- Pen test: procurement prefers Jan 10–14, vendor TBD — procurement@finlay.com is the point of contact. We will require proof of insurance and an NDA prior to the test.

Attaching Finlay-compliance-questions.pdf with a short list from our audit team. 

If you can get the SOC2 snapshot and a 7-day CSV sample by Tue (12/8), that will let us move to legal review early next week.

Best,
Samira Khalid
Senior Director, Compliance & Risk
Finlay Financial
samira@finlay.com

On Sun, Dec 6, 2026 at 09:12 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Jonas — looping in Neha for the runbook. Quick internal alignment following Samira / Tom's asks: ...

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khalid <samira@finlay.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@finlay.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@finlay.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & retention qualification — next steps and ops milestones

Samira / Tom — thanks for the clarifications. Confirming commitments and deliverables from Redwood: 

Deliverables and timeline
- SOC2-snapshot-summary.pdf (high-level summary of last Type II scope, control owners, date) — delivery: Tue 12/8 EOD.
- auditlog-sample-202611.csv (7-day redacted CSV with requested fields + checksum column) — delivery: Tue 12/8 EOD.
- DPA_draft_Redwood_v1.docx (our standard DPA, with subprocessor appendix) — delivery: Wed 12/9.
- pen-test-procurement-checklist.pdf (insurance/NDA requirements and suggested scope for Jan 10–14) — delivery: Wed 12/9.

Notes
- Retention export: we can provide exports for the full 6-year retention upon request; operationally this is an on-demand export that can be stored in your S3 bucket under the DPA. We will indicate in the DPA the mechanics and expected lead time (typically 3–5 business days for a >1 year export).
- Encryption: data at rest is encrypted AES-256; default keys are Redwood-managed KMS keys, but customer-managed keys are available under Private deployments (noted in DPA appendix).
- Pen test: we will produce the required proof of insurance and a vendor NDA template when procurement confirms vendor details.

Attachments I will send in the follow-up email: SOC2-snapshot-summary.pdf, auditlog-sample-202611.csv, DPA draft link, pen-test-procurement-checklist.pdf. Also sharing a Drive folder for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cFinlay-Artifact-Handbook.

If anything changes on your side (different pen test window or additional artifact requests), reply-all and we’ll adapt. Otherwise we’ll proceed on the dates above.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
